download_url.description: API URL of the delivered MP3 in the run's key-value store. Fetch with an Apify API token, or use the Apify MCP server get-key-value-store-record tool with key_value_store_id and file_key.

error.description: True when the run failed to deliver anything. No charge is made on error items.

error_code.description: Machine-readable error code, present only on error items.

error_message.description: Human-readable error detail, present only on error items.

event_charged.description: The pay-per-event event charged for this delivery: track-delivered ($5.99) or album-delivered ($14.99).

evidence.description: Biometric evidence summary for this track: heart-rate variability (RMSSD) measured by camera during sessions while the track played. Nulls mean no sessions recorded for this track yet.

mean_heart_rate_bpm.description: Mean heart rate (bpm) across valid sessions, or null.

mean_rmssd_ms.description: Mean RMSSD (ms) across valid sessions, or null.

note.description: What the evidence numbers mean, honestly stated.

valid_sessions.description: Number of valid biometric sessions for this track.

file_key.description: Key of the delivered audio file in the run's key-value store.

file_size_bytes.description: Size of the delivered audio file in bytes.

format.description: Audio format of the delivered file: mp3 (320 kbps), or wav when the WAV master was delivered because transcoding was unavailable.

key_value_store_id.description: ID of the run's key-value store holding the delivered file.

license.description: Single-buyer license terms for the delivered track.

price_usd.description: Price charged for this delivery in USD.

purchase.description: Whether this item came from a track purchase or an album purchase.
